To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the botnet is a very serious threat to Internet security, and that the only solution to the botnet threat is to prevent the infection of the machines in the first place.

(i) botnets are a major threat to the internet; (ii) botnet activity is a serious problem that affects the security and stability of the Internet; (iii) botnet activity can be detected and mitigated using the techniques and tools presented in this paper; (iv) botnets are becoming increasingly sophisticated, and new techniques are constantly being developed; (v) botnet detection is a challenging task, and there is still much research to be done in this area.

(i) the botnet detection problem can be formulated as a binary classification problem; (ii) we have developed a novel botnet detection method based on the use of a Support Vector Machine (SVM) and a novel feature selection method based on the concept of the Information Gain (IG); (iii) we have shown that our proposed method can be applied in real-world scenarios, and that the method is effective in detecting botnet activities in the Internet.
